title: Fruit juice concentrate
name: Fruit juice concentrate
aliases: fruit juice concentrate, concentrated fruit juice, fruit concentrate, apple juice concentrate, grape juice concentrate, pear juice concentrate
what_is: Fruit juice from which water has been removed, concentrating the natural sugars.
why_botia: Concentrating fruit juice means removing the water: what remains is the fruit sugar without the fruit. WHO counts it in the same free-sugar category as added sugar, but on the ingredient list it reads as fruit — and that changes how you perceive it.
can_1: Detect fruit juice concentrates on ingredient labels.
can_2: Explain that its sugars count as free sugars under WHO criteria.
can_3: Categorise them as WHO free sugar (fruit concentrate group).
cannot_1: Distinguish between different types of fruit concentrate used.
cannot_2: Quantify the exact sugar content from the concentrate alone.
cannot_3: Tell you the total sugar content — check the nutrition label.

sources.label: WHO — Guideline: Sugars intake for adults and children (2015)
Regulation (EC) No 1924/2006 on nutrition and health claims made on foods — current consolidated text

description: Fruit juice with the water removed — WHO counts its sugars as free sugars.
